title: Chapter 112 — Scheduling, Communication, and The Operating Cadence
intro: Staffing logic, communication systems, and the store's rhythms.

sections.title: The Store Runs on Rhythm
sections.content:
Every well-run store has a cadence: morning huddle, floor coverage schedule, lunch rotation, promotional changeover timing, delivery coordination windows, and end-of-day close-out.

Salespeople who understand the rhythm work with it instead of against it. They know when traffic peaks. They know when to schedule follow-up calls. They know when the floor needs coverage and when they can step away for CRM work.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating operational rhythm, ask:

Does the salesperson work with the store's operating cadence — or fight it?
Do they understand staffing logic and peak traffic patterns?
Do they communicate effectively with the operations team?
